dedupe_keys.name: riverine flood insurance assessment indicators for eu regions under climate and socio economic change coacch

description: Expected annual river flood damage, flood insurance premiums and insurance penetration rates for EU regions at NUTS2 level under future climate and socio-economic conditions, given as combinations of Representative Concentration Pathways and Shared Socioeconomic Pathways. The Zenodo record, published on 29 September 2021 by Max Tesselaar (IVM, Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam) in the COACCH (CO-designing the Assessment of Climate CHange costs) H2020 community, holds 16 small CSV files (about 0.7 MB in all): one file each of expected annual damage, premium and penetration rate for RCP2.6-SSP1, RCP2.6-SSP2, RCP4.5-SSP2, RCP6.0-SSP2 and RCP8.5-SSP5, plus a metadata file. It is free to download under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is EU regions. Caveats: values come from a model of insurance demand and flood risk described in the linked research, not from observed market data, and years and units must be checked in the metadata file. For simulation it gives regional flood insurance premiums and uptake under climate scenarios, to test how insurance coverage changes household and business recovery after floods. Related catalogue records include the COACCH supply chain shocks dataset and the FEMA NFIP redacted claims.
